name: nginx-multisite
description: Core Nginx web server cookbook that configures a multi-site reverse proxy with SSL termination, security hardening (fail2ban, ufw, sysctl, SSH), and firewall management across three named virtual hosts.

name: cache
description: Caching layer cookbook that installs and configures both Memcached and Redis on the same node, including a post-install config-patching workaround to remove deprecated Redis replica directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Application deployment cookbook that clones a FastAPI Python app from GitHub, sets up a Python virtual environment, provisions a PostgreSQL database and user, and registers a systemd service to run the app via uvicorn.
